exposure: operative delivery by vacuum or forceps extraction
cohort: The study included 101 healthy women without SUI (control group) and 98 patients with SUI (study group).
finding: Parity, gravidity, vaginal delivery, Kristeller maneuver, operative delivery by vacuum or forceps extraction, and delivery of macrosomic fetus were found to be significant risk factors for SUI.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery, specifically vaginal delivery and operative delivery by vacuum or forceps extraction, significantly impacts subsequent SUI, with timely cesarean section potentially preventing SUI.
birth_weight: N/A (macrosomic fetus mentioned as a risk factor)
